description: An assessment of run of river hydropower potential in Great Britain is a data set deposited in University of Strathclyde by its authors Ana-Diana Golgojan. The input data used to determine the run of river hydropower potential in GB. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 503MB. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
